title: AI Large Models Will Fully Embrace IPv6, Xiongan New Area Leads the Pilot of a Standalone Network
excerpt: The Cyberspace Administration of China, together with the cyberspace administrations of Beijing, Shanghai, Zhejiang, and Shenzhen, and five leading large model
content_html:
The Cyberspace Administration of China, together with the cyberspace administrations of Beijing, Shanghai, Zhejiang, and Shenzhen, and five leading large model enterprises, officially launched the "Artificial Intelligence Large Model IPv6 Capability Enhancement Special Action" today in Xiongan New Area. This one-year initiative aims to comprehensively support generative AI large models with IPv6, laying a solid network foundation for the intelligent era.

As AI large model applications flourish, token traffic is experiencing explosive growth, placing unprecedented pressure on network capacity. IPv6, with its 128-bit address "massive set of door numbers"—capable of assigning an address to each grain of sand on Earth—and efficient routing mechanisms and built-in security capabilities—is seen as the key infrastructure supporting large model applications.

Four Key Areas of Focus: API Calls as Core Metrics

This special action will focus on four dimensions simultaneously: enhancing the large model's IPv6 scalability, improving management standards, increasing the IPv6 support level of infrastructure, and promoting the IPv6 traffic expansion of large model applications. Particularly important is increasing the IPv6 access ratio of large model API calls, which means that communication traffic between future AI applications will fully migrate to the next-generation network protocol. The ultimate goal of this action is to promote the deep integration and innovation of large models and IPv6, driving the Internet toward a "native intelligence" direction.

On the same day, the IPv6 single-stack deployment initiative in Xiongan New Area was also officially launched. A "single stack" refers to a network that only operates with the IPv6 protocol and no longer relies on IPv4 compatibility. Xiongan will work collaboratively from four dimensions—strengthening fundamentals, widespread empowerment, enhanced R&D, and ecosystem development—with plans to achieve full-scale IPv6 single-stack operation in newly built areas by 2030.

2030 Goal: 950 million IPv6 Users, 42% Traffic Share

Recently, the Central Committee for Cybersecurity and Informatization issued the "Implementation Plan for Deepening IPv6 Technology Innovation and Integrated Application (2026–2030)", setting clear two-phase goals. By 2027, the number of active IPv6 users will reach 900 million, with network traffic accounting for 38%. By 2030, active IPv6 users will further increase to 950 million, with traffic share rising to 42%. IPv6 will be widely integrated into all fields of the economy and society, building a technically advanced and secure IPv6 industry ecosystem. From the single-stack pilot in Xiongan to the nationwide IPv6 promotion, this series of measures indicates that China is carrying out a systematic upgrade of network infrastructure for the era of AI large models.

content_html_zh:
国家网信办联合北京、上海、浙江、深圳等市网信部门以及5家龙头大型示范企业今天在雄安新区正式启动“人工智能大型示范IPv6能力提升专项行动”。 这一为期一年的举措旨在通过IPv6全面支持生成式人工智能大模型，为智能时代奠定坚实的网络基础。

随着AI大模型应用的蓬勃发展，代币流量爆发式增长，给网络容量带来前所未有的压力。 IPv6 凭借其 128 位地址“海量门牌号”（能够为地球上的每一粒沙子分配地址）以及高效的路由机制和内置安全功能，被视为支持大型模型应用的关键基础设施。

四个关键关注领域：API 调用作为核心指标

此次专项行动将同时聚焦四个维度：增强大模型IPv6扩展能力、完善管理标准、提高基础设施IPv6支撑水平、推动大模型应用IPv6流量扩展。 尤为重要的是提高大模型API调用的IPv6接入比例，这意味着未来AI应用之间的通信流量将全面迁移到下一代网络协议。 这一行动的最终目标是推动大模型与IPv6的深度融合与创新，驱动互联网向“原生智能”方向发展。

同日，雄安新区IPv6单栈部署举措也正式启动。 “单栈”是指仅使用 IPv6 协议运行且不再依赖 IPv4 兼容性的网络。 雄安将从强化基础、广泛赋能、加强研发、生态建设四个维度协同推进，计划到2030年新建区域全面实现IPv6单栈运行。

2030 年目标：9.5 亿 IPv6 用户，42% 流量份额

近日，中央网络安全和信息化委员会印发《深化IPv6技术创新和融合应用实施方案（2026-2030年）》，明确了两阶段目标。 到2027年，IPv6活跃用户数将达到9亿，网络流量占比38%。 到2030年，IPv6活跃用户将进一步增加到9.5亿，流量份额上升到42%。 IPv6将广泛融入经济社会各领域，构建技术先进、安全的IPv6产业生态系统。 从雄安单栈试点到IPv6全国推广，这一系列举措表明我国正在针对AI大模型时代进行网络基础设施的系统升级。
